{{Top|leg}}
'''Myoplexaril''' was a type of muscle relaxant used during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]] used myoplexaril on a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] patient he was operating on in order to lift its abdominal scale plates.<ref name="MedStar II" />
